notes.title: YouTube Support Added!
notes.notes: You can now stream all your favorite songs right from YouTube! After going to song select, simply check the YouTube box next to the filter in the upper right, then select the filter to enter the name of the song you want to search for on YouTube. In the case where you aren't able to enter the text using the provided keyboard, use the paste button on the keyboard to paste whatever text is currently copied in your clipboard.

notes.title: Added super meter
notes.notes: I've added a super meter to the game to make it a little easier to come back if you were previously doing well, but later screwed up. With the super meter active, you can build your minion and castle meters super fast, allowing you to quickly upgrade your castle or send out some more minions if you find yourself in a pinch!

notes.title: New Patch Info
notes.notes:
1. Fixed bug that could cause the 1st note to spawn too high.
2. Fixed bug in cross cut animation.
3. Enabled single pass stereo rendering.
4. Tweaked difficulty.
5. Updated score system to make a higher rank score easier to attain.
6. Added text backgrounds to make text more readable.
